# Practical Machinist

> > The world's largest online community for machinists, CNC operators, and manufacturing professionals to share knowledge, tools, and industry expertise.

Practical Machinist operates as both a vibrant community forum and an ecommerce platform serving the metalworking and manufacturing industry. The site connects North American and international professionals through discussion forums, educational resources, and branded merchandise.

## Key Topics

- CNC machining
- Metalworking
- Manufacturing forum
- Machinist community
- G-Code
- XenForo platform
- Mobile access
- User registration
- Machinist apparel
- Branded products
- eCommerce
- Manufacturing technology
- Metalworking industry

## Community Forum

- [Practical Machinist - Largest Manufacturing Technology Forum](https://www.practicalmachinist.com/forum): World's largest machinist, CNC and manufacturing community forum for sharing knowledge and industry expertise

## Shop & Merchandise

- [Practical Machinist eShop - Practical Machinist](https://shop.practicalmachinist.com): Practical Machinist merchandise store with branded apparel, t-shirts, and machinist products
